ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the legend there are types such as railway passenger station, highway, science and technology area, residential area, industrial area, green area, and agricultural area. In the figure, urban construction functional areas such as the science and technology area, residential area, industrial area, and green area are mainly concentrated within the same urban area; they are adjacent to one another and basically connected into a whole. On the periphery, agricultural areas are distributed, and roads and rivers pass through or are near the city. Then reason: The question stem requires judging the spatial layout form of this city. Since the construction functional areas in the figure are not dispersed into multiple mutually independent groups, but instead form a relatively compact and continuous urban outline, this conforms to the characteristics of the “concentrated type” in urban spatial forms.

method.method_draft: 读取题干确认要求判断“该城市的空间布局形态”。再读图例，区分城市建设用地与外围农业区；观察各建设功能区在图中的相互位置，发现它们基本连成一个整体，城市轮廓较紧凑，并未形成若干独立组团。依据城市空间形态分类规则，判定为空间布局形态为“集中式”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图例中有铁路客运站、公路、科技区、生活区、工业区、绿化区、农业区等类型。图中科技区、生活区、工业区、绿化区等城市建设功能区主要集中在同一片城市范围内，彼此相邻并基本连成一个整体；外围则分布有农业区，道路和河流穿过或邻近城市。再推理：题干要求判断该城市的空间布局形态。由于图中各建设功能区没有分散成多个相互独立的组团，而是组成较紧凑、连续的城市轮廓，符合城市空间形态中“集中式”的特征。
